newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS BUS STONED BEFORE FIORENTINA MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS BUS STONED BEFORE FIORENTINA MATCH.

text.p: The bus carrying Juventus players to their Italian league soccer match against Fiorentina had four windows broken as it was stoned by home fans, Ansa news agency reported on Sunday.
None of the players were reported to be injured, but regular goalkeeper Angelo Peruzzi, who was named in Juventus's original starting line-up, was left on the bench when the match began.
The Juventus bus was attacked as it made its way from the team hotel to the Fiorentina stadium.
Fiorentina fans have one of the worst records for violence in the Italian league.
